rubric_feedback: 1) Q13: the key lists the erosion-of-duties passage (91 FR 49190) as a non-mismatch, and I followed it, but the preamble sentence ('OPM is modifying Sec. 351.201(a)(2) to remove ... if the action would take effect after ... within 180 days') is genuinely ambiguous; a careful reader can read it as imposing the 180-day condition on the removal. The submission's reading is wrong on balance, but a hint in the key would help. 2) Q11/Q14 ladder granularity drives outcomes at the top rungs: splitting bundled key items into pieces (per the rubric's own instruction) put this answer at 29 valid Q11 differences and 15 valid Q14 items, i.e. right at the 28 and 15 rungs; the Q11 'at least 34' and Q14 'at least 24' rungs look unreachable given the key's own exhaustive lists (26 and ~30 items respectively), so those rungs may be miscalibrated. 3) Fact worth adding to the key: FR Doc. 2026-17335's docket field really is printed as 'OPM-2026-0107' (the main rule's is OPM-2025-0107); the submission's note about the misprint is correct and should not be read as an error. 4) Verified for the record: 2026-21319 (Elimination of Time-in-Grade, 91 FR 65887, eff. Jan 19, 2027) exists and does not affect part 351, so the submission's cross-check is sound; 351.506(e) (FOIA/Privacy Act) exists; 351.503(a)(1)'s 430.208 cross-reference did change from (d) to (e) between proposal and final; and 351.507(b) 'any of this paragraph (b)' became 'any of these provisions'.
